documents_expected.why: Instructions for Applicants (Word): eligibility, format, expenses

eligibility.rule: Nonprofits, schools, local governments and individuals working in Iowa
eligibility.quote: Nonprofit organizations, educational institutions, local government entities (e.g., municipalities, county conservation boards), and individuals working in Iowa are welcome to apply.

eligibility.rule: Project aligns with IPN's mission and shows its expected impact
eligibility.quote: Projects must align with IPN's mission and clearly demonstrate their expected impact.
alt_quotes: Projects must align with IPN’s mission and clearly demonstrate their expected impact.

eligibility.rule: Prairie restoration, management or protection, research or monitoring, or education or training
eligibility.quote: Projects in the following categories will be considered eligible for funding:

eligibility.rule: Work completed within 18 months of receiving the funds
eligibility.quote: a timeline of activities (to be completed within 18 months of receipt of funds)

documents.item: Application template with every section completed
documents.quote: Download a copy of the IPN Grant Application Template and complete each section.
alt_quotes: download a copy of the IPN Grant Application Form and complete each section.

documents.quote: Proposal Budget and Justification: Clearly outline how each budget item supports your project’s success.

documents.item: Advisor's letter of support for student applicants
documents.quote: Student applications should include a letter of support from the student’s advisor.

effort.step: Email the proposal to the small grants address
effort.quote: Submit your proposal via email by November 30, 2026, to be considered for funding effective January 31, 2027.

co_finance_required.quote: While matching funds are not required, they are encouraged—especially for larger projects.

notes: The rules are in the Instructions for Applicants Word file (gather reads .docx since gather-3). Proposal up to 5 pages; applicants at institutions submit through their grants office.
